## ListBox

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/list_box/list_box.hpp>
class ListBox : public Panel
```

ListBox is a retained virtual-row selector with single, multi-simple, and multi-extended policies; stable item identities; scroll-window projection; keyboard/pointer range selection; activation; and virtual child semantics.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `ListBox`.

- Virtual-row selector with single, multi-simple, and multi-extended selection policies over stable item identities.
- Projects a scroll window, supports keyboard and pointer range selection and activation, and publishes list semantics.

CheckedListBox extends ListBox with an independently retained three-state check model, cancellable pre-change events, committed change events, optional check-on-click, configurable indicator geometry, and checkable virtual semantics.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `CheckedListBox`.

- Extends `ListBox` with an independently retained three-state check model.
- Publishes a cancellable pre-change event followed by a committed change event; check-on-click and indicator geometry are configurable.

ComboBox is a retained noneditable choice field with authoritative item selection, placeholder projection, keyboard cycling, a source-private transient ListBox, bounded item count, independent popup width, focus-safe lifetime handling, and option semantics.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `ComboBox`.

- A noneditable choice field. Item selection is authoritative; placeholder text is projected when nothing is selected; keyboard cycling changes the selection without opening the popup.
- The drop-down list is a source-private transient `ListBox` with an independently bounded popup width and item count.

## TreeView

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/panel/tree_view/tree_view.hpp>
class TreeView final : public Panel
```

TreeView is a virtualized retained hierarchy over caller-owned stable item identities. It derives the visible preorder from expansion state, keeps selection and active focus distinct, supports configurable row geometry and expander presentation, and projects virtual tree-item semantics without materializing child controls.

Status: stable. WinForms counterpart: `TreeView`.

- A virtualized retained hierarchy over caller-owned stable item identities; the visible preorder is derived from expansion state.
- Selection and active focus are distinct; expansion, keyboard traversal, and semantics follow the retained model.

**Members**

| `void on_paint(Painter& painter, Rect local_damage) override` | Records only realized compact or expanded rows, status rails, matched excerpts, hover, selection, and focus. |
| `void on_pointer(PointerEvent& event) override` | Handles hover intent, selection, pin toggling, context requests, capture qualification, and activation. |
| `void on_key(KeyEvent& event) override` | Implements variable-height navigation, paging, expansion/pinning, activation, and context request. |
| `void on_focus_changed(bool focused) override` | Commits focus appearance and restores a usable focused result on entry. |
| `SemanticDescriptor semantic_descriptor() const override` | Projects a result list with total and realized counts plus current selection. |
| `std::vector<SemanticNode> semantic_virtual_children() const override` | Exposes stable result nodes with correspondence descriptions, expanded/selected state, and actions. |
| `bool on_semantic_child_action(std::string_view stable_id, SemanticAction action, std::string_view value) override` | Routes virtual selection, expansion, collapse, and press through ordinary retained transitions. |

**Protected members**

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `void on_detached_from_window() noexcept override` |  |

(api-gui-forms-choicegroup)=

```cpp
#include <gui_forms/controls/collections/choice_group.hpp>
class ChoiceGroup final : public Panel
```

ChoiceGroup is a Panel-derived collection control that presents authored ChoiceItem records as retained item Buttons forming one exclusive selection; the selected index is a bindable Value\<int\> with changed and activated events, keyboard traversal, named skin parts, and group semantics.
